messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Why is spironolactone described as a high-risk medicine?
:
The main reason is the risk of a high potassium level.
A high potassium level can cause a dangerous change in your heart rhythm.
A high potassium level often gives no warning symptoms.
The risk rises if your kidneys do not work well.
The risk rises if you take other medicines that raise potassium.
Several very common medicines raise potassium.
Ibuprofen is a very common medicine that raises potassium.
Some blood pressure tablets are very common medicines that raise potassium.
This risk is manageable.
Blood tests are built into treatment.
Your potassium should be checked within a week of starting spironolactone or changing your dose.
It should be checked regularly after that.
Spironolactone also needs care in pregnancy and in people with liver disease.
Triplet: ["risk of high potassium level", "increases in", "impaired kidney function"]

The relation 'increases in' in the triplet is defined as 'The risk specified by the subject entity is heightened or becomes more significant in the condition or situation specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'higher risk in': The object condition or situation increases the likelihood of the subject condition occurring.
B. 'more common in': The subject condition or event occurs more frequently in the group or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
D. 'can worsen': The subject drug may increase the severity or negative impact of the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'caused by': The subject condition or event is caused by the entity specified by the object.
F. None of the above.
